summary:
Implemented the next Garage staging slice.

Changed `garage.js` so the Final Part Numbers panel now has separate `Use Need List` and `Use Staged List` actions. After Counter Mode reaches all-staged, the user can open Final Parts and draft from the completed staged lines before manually saving confirmed part numbers into Truck Profile. Updated search metadata, service-worker cache `v308`, smoke coverage, and Anton roadmap/state/audit notes.

Verified:
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1` passed.
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html')` passed.
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html') -Tag audit-v308-staged-final-parts -SkipScreenshots` passed.
- iPhone-width Playwright screenshot/check passed: `debug-screenshots/audit-v308-staged-final-parts-mobile-garage.png`.

Next slice: real-iPhone review of the Counter Mode completion, Use Staged List, Save Run Note, final-parts handoff, and iOS share-sheet behavior before adding any inventory/schema behavior.

Impact Score: 4/5  
Visible Change: Garage Final Part Numbers can now draft from already staged parts-counter lines after Counter Mode is complete.  
Impact Reason: This makes the iPhone parts-counter workflow more useful at the exact end of a store run without adding schema or unsourced vehicle facts.
